name: HC-ChiSep Validation Protocol
description: Acquisition protocol to validate HC-ChiSep (hollow-cylinder chi-separation with signal-derived fibre orientation) on real data. Four acquisitions: multi-echo GRE (QSM/R2*/orientation beat), multi-echo spin echo (R2' + MWF myelin reference), single-shell DTI (fibre-orientation ground truth), and T1w (segmentation/ROIs). Adapts the ISMRM QSM consensus (https://doi.org/10.1002/mrm.30006) and adds HC-ChiSep-specific requirements (long echo train, MESE-MWF, DTI-theta). Non-DICOM-checkable items (monopolar readout, reverse-PE b0, second head orientation, B0 recording, processing) are documented in each acquisition's detailed description.

Multi-Echo GRE (MEGRE).description: 3D RF-spoiled multi-echo GRE — supplies QSM phase, R2*, and the multi-compartment magnitude beat for HC-ChiSep.
Multi-Echo GRE (MEGRE).detailed_description:
## Multi-Echo GRE (MEGRE) — primary HC-ChiSep input

3D RF-spoiled multi-echo gradient-echo. This single acquisition supplies **three** of HC-ChiSep's inputs: the **phase** -> QSM (chi_total), the **magnitude** -> R2* (for R2' = R2* - R2), and the multi-echo magnitude **decay ("beat")** from which HC-ChiSep derives white-matter fibre orientation and myelin-water fraction.

### Key requirements (auto-validated where possible)
- **RF-spoiled 3D GRE, monopolar readout.** Monopolar avoids even/odd-echo phase mismatch.
- **>= 8 echoes (ideally 10-12).** The hollow-cylinder multi-compartment beat needs dense temporal sampling; 4-echo in-vivo data saturated the fibre-angle estimate at 90 deg. This is the single most important parameter for HC-ChiSep.
- **Short first echo (TE1 ~ 3 ms)** to capture the fast-decaying myelin-water pool.
- **Short, uniform echo spacing (dTE ~ 3-4 ms).** Longest TE ~ tissue T2* (~30-40 ms at 3T).
- **Isotropic voxels <= 1 mm**, whole-brain coverage (whole head for background-field removal).
- **Save BOTH magnitude and phase** DICOMs for every echo (phase is essential for QSM).

### Manual checks (NOT verifiable from DICOM — confirm at the console)
- **Monopolar (fly-back) readout** — vendor-specific; not reliably in standard DICOM tags. Ensure monopolar, not bipolar.
- **Second, tilted head orientation (~20-30 deg)** — OPTIONAL but high value: acquiring a second MEGRE with the head rotated directly probes the orientation (theta) dependence that is HC-ChiSep's core novelty (the same design principle as the digital phantom). Even one extra orientation strengthens the validation substantially.
- **Record the B0 direction / head positioning** — HC-ChiSep's fibre angle is defined relative to B0. ImageOrientationPatient captures this in DICOM; just note any deliberate tilt.
- **Coil >= 12 channels, parallel imaging / acceleration** as per QSM consensus.

### What it validates in HC-ChiSep
Magnitude beat -> signal-derived fibre angle (validate against DTI) and myelin-water fraction (validate against MESE-MWF); phase -> chi_total; magnitude decay -> R2*.

rules.name: RF-Spoiled (recommended)
rules.description: RF-spoiled (SequenceVariant 'SP') is recommended for clean QSM phase.

rules.name: Echo Count (>=8)
rules.description: HC-ChiSep needs a long echo train to sample the multi-compartment beat; >=8 echoes required, 10-12 ideal.

parameterDefinitions.label: Minimum echoes
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if fewer unique echoes than this

parameterDefinitions.name: recommended_echoes
parameterDefinitions.label: Recommended echoes
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if fewer unique echoes than this (optional)

parameterDefinitions.label: Exact echoes
parameterDefinitions.description: Require exactly this many echoes (overrides min/recommended)

rules.name: Short First Echo
rules.description: TE1 should be as short as possible (~3 ms) to capture the fast-decaying myelin-water pool.
rules.implementation:
te1 = value["EchoTime"].dropna().min()
max_te = params.get("max_first_te")
if max_te is not None and te1 > max_te:
    raise ValidationError(f"First TE too long ({te1} ms); must be <= {max_te} ms.")
pref = params.get("preferred_first_te")
if pref is not None and te1 > pref:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"First TE could be shorter ({te1} ms); <= {pref} ms preferred.")

parameterDefinitions.name: max_first_te
parameterDefinitions.label: Maximum first TE
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if the first echo time exceeds this

parameterDefinitions.name: preferred_first_te
parameterDefinitions.label: Preferred first TE
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if the first echo time exceeds this (optional)

rules.name: Uniform Echo Spacing
rules.description: Echo spacing (dTE) must be uniform for R2*/beat fitting.
rules.implementation:
te = value["EchoTime"].dropna().sort_values()
spacings = te.diff().iloc[1:]
tol = params.get("tolerance_ms") or 0.1
if len(spacings) > 0 and not all(abs(spacings.iloc[0] - s) <= tol for s in spacings):
    raise ValidationError(f"Echo spacing not uniform (tolerance {tol} ms). Found spacings: {list(spacings.round(3))}.")

parameterDefinitions.name: tolerance_ms
parameterDefinitions.label: Tolerance
parameterDefinitions.description: Maximum allowed deviation between echo spacings

rules.name: Short Echo Spacing (<=4 ms)
rules.description: dTE should be short (~3-4 ms) so the fast myelin-water decay is sampled.
rules.implementation:
te = value["EchoTime"].dropna().sort_values()
dte = te.diff().iloc[1:].mean()
max_dte = params.get("max_mean_spacing_ms")
if max_dte is not None and dte > max_dte:
    raise ValidationError(f"Mean dTE {dte:.1f} ms too long; must be <= {max_dte} ms.")
pref = params.get("preferred_mean_spacing_ms")
if pref is not None and dte > pref:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Mean dTE {dte:.1f} ms; <= {pref} ms preferred.")

parameterDefinitions.name: max_mean_spacing_ms
parameterDefinitions.label: Maximum mean spacing
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if the mean echo spacing exceeds this

parameterDefinitions.name: preferred_mean_spacing_ms
parameterDefinitions.label: Preferred mean spacing
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if the mean echo spacing exceeds this

rules.name: Magnitude + Phase per Echo
rules.description: Each echo must have both a magnitude and a phase image (phase is essential for QSM).

rules.name: Isotropic Voxels <=1 mm
rules.description: Use isotropic voxels of at most 1 mm edge to limit partial-volume error in white matter.
rules.implementation:
ps = value["PixelSpacing"].iloc[0]
st = value["SliceThickness"].iloc[0]
tol = params.get("isotropy_tolerance_mm") or 0.1
max_edge = params.get("max_edge_mm")
if abs(ps[0]-ps[1]) > tol or abs(ps[0]-st) > tol:
    raise ValidationError(f"Voxels not isotropic (tolerance {tol} mm). PixelSpacing {ps}, SliceThickness {st}.")
if max_edge is not None and max(ps[0], ps[1], st) > max_edge:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Voxel edge {max(ps[0],ps[1],st)} mm exceeds {max_edge} mm.")

parameterDefinitions.name: max_edge_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Maximum voxel edge
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if the largest voxel dimension exceeds this

parameterDefinitions.name: isotropy_tolerance_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Isotropy tolerance
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if voxel dimensions differ from each other by more than this

Multi-Echo Spin Echo (MESE).description: Multi-echo spin echo (CPMG) — R2 map for R2', and (>=32 echoes) an MWF myelin reference.
Multi-Echo Spin Echo (MESE).detailed_description:
## Multi-Echo Spin Echo (MESE) — R2 for R2', and myelin (MWF) reference

Multi-echo (CPMG) spin echo. Its primary job is the **R2 map** so that **R2' = R2* - R2** can be formed (R2* comes from the MEGRE). With enough echoes it **doubles as a multi-component T2 -> myelin-water-fraction (MWF) map**, giving an *independent* reference for HC-ChiSep's diamagnetic (chi-, myelin) arm.

### Key requirements (auto-validated where possible)
- **Spin-echo (SE), CPMG multi-echo** train.
- **>= 32 echoes for MWF** (dTE ~ 8-10 ms, TE1 ~ 10 ms). >= 8 echoes is the bare minimum for R2 alone.
- **Uniform echo spacing.**

### Manual checks (NOT verifiable from DICOM)
- **Same geometry/coverage as the MEGRE** (or at least resample-able) so R2' = R2* - R2 is voxelwise valid. Prescribe from the same localiser.
- **CPMG / stimulated-echo handling** — for quantitative MWF, use a sequence with known refocusing/B1 behaviour (or acquire a B1 map). GRASE is an acceptable faster alternative.
- SNR matters for MWF; in-plane resolution can be coarser than the MEGRE.

### What it validates in HC-ChiSep
R2 (with R2* from MEGRE) -> R2' input; multi-component T2 -> MWF, an independent check of HC-ChiSep's chi- / myelin output.

Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI).description: Single-shell EPI diffusion (b~1000, >=30 dir + b0) — tensor V1 gives the fibre-orientation ground truth.
Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI).detailed_description:
## Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI) — orientation ground truth

Single-shell diffusion for tensor fitting. Its principal eigenvector (V1) gives the **true white-matter fibre orientation**, whose **angle to B0** is the ground truth for validating HC-ChiSep's signal-derived fibre angle (theta) — the method's core novelty.

### Key requirements (auto-validated where possible)
- **Echo-planar diffusion (EP).**
- **Single shell b ~ 1000 s/mm^2** plus **>= 1 b=0**.
- **>= 30 directions (60 ideal)** for a robust tensor / stable V1.

### Manual checks (NOT verifiable from DICOM)
- **Reverse phase-encode b=0 (blip-up/blip-down)** for topup/distortion correction — ESSENTIAL to undistort the EPI before registering to the (undistorted) MEGRE, or the theta comparison is invalid. DICOM cannot encode blip polarity, so confirm a reverse-PE b0 (or full reverse-PE series) was acquired.
- **Registration** DTI -> MEGRE space (rigid + distortion correction) is a processing step; V1 must be reoriented with the transform.
- ~2 mm isotropic is typical; match/resample as needed.

### What it validates in HC-ChiSep
DTI tensor -> V1 -> angle(V1, B0) = DTI-theta, correlated against HC-ChiSep's signal-theta within white matter.

rules.name: b=0 and b~1000 Shell
rules.description: Need at least one b=0 and a diffusion-weighted shell around b=1000 s/mm^2 for tensor fitting.
rules.implementation:
b = sorted(float(x) for x in value["DiffusionBValue"].dropna().unique())
if not b:
    raise ValidationError("No DiffusionBValue found — is this a diffusion series?")

def parse_ranges(spec):
    ranges = []
    for part in [p.strip() for p in str(spec or "").split(",") if p.strip()]:
        lo_str, _, hi_str = part.partition("-")
        ranges.append((float(lo_str), float(hi_str) if hi_str else float(lo_str)))
    return ranges

found = [int(round(x)) for x in b]
missing = [f"{lo:g}-{hi:g}" for lo, hi in parse_ranges(params.get("required_ranges"))
           if not any(lo <= x <= hi for x in b)]
if missing:
    raise ValidationError(f"Missing required b-value range(s) {', '.join(missing)} s/mm². Found: {found}")
recommended = [f"{lo:g}-{hi:g}" for lo, hi in parse_ranges(params.get("recommended_ranges"))
              if not any(lo <= x <= hi for x in b)]
if recommended:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Missing recommended b-value range(s) {', '.join(recommended)} s/mm². Found: {found}")

parameterDefinitions.label: Required ranges
parameterDefinitions.description: Comma-separated 'lo-hi' b-value ranges (s/mm²) that must each contain at least one b-value

parameterDefinitions.name: recommended_ranges
parameterDefinitions.label: Recommended ranges
parameterDefinitions.description: Ranges that produce a warning when no b-value falls within them

rules.description: >=30 unique diffusion directions (60 ideal) for a stable tensor and reliable V1.

T1-weighted (T1w).description: 3D ~1 mm isotropic IR-prepared T1w (MPRAGE/BRAVO) for segmentation and ROI definition.
T1-weighted (T1w).detailed_description:
## T1-weighted (T1w) — segmentation & ROIs

3D IR-prepared T1w (MPRAGE / BRAVO) for tissue segmentation (GM/WM/deep-gray) and atlas registration, providing the ROIs for chi+ (deep-gray iron) and chi- (fibre-bundle) analysis.

### Key requirements (auto-validated where possible)
- **3D acquisition, ~1 mm isotropic**, whole head.
- **IR-prepared** (InversionTime present) for strong GM/WM contrast.

### Manual checks (NOT verifiable from DICOM)
- Same session as the MEGRE; will be registered to MEGRE space for segmentation transfer.

### What it validates / enables
GM/WM/deep-gray segmentation + fibre-bundle atlas -> the ROIs over which HC-ChiSep chi+ (iron) and chi- (myelin) are summarised; deep-gray iron serves as a soft chi+ correlate (no direct in-vivo iron ground truth exists).

rules.name: IR-Prepared T1w
rules.description: An inversion-recovery-prepared T1w (MPRAGE/BRAVO) gives the best GM/WM contrast for segmentation.

rules.name: ~1 mm Isotropic
rules.description: Use ~1 mm isotropic voxels, whole head.
rules.implementation:
ps = value["PixelSpacing"].iloc[0]
st = value["SliceThickness"].iloc[0]
tol = params.get("isotropy_tolerance_mm") or 0.1
max_edge = params.get("max_edge_mm")
if abs(ps[0]-ps[1]) > tol or abs(ps[0]-st) > tol:
    raise ValidationError(f"Voxels not isotropic (tolerance {tol} mm). PixelSpacing {ps}, SliceThickness {st}.")
if max_edge is not None and max(ps[0], ps[1], st) > max_edge:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Voxel edge {max(ps[0],ps[1],st)} mm exceeds {max_edge} mm.")
